web_app.goal: Build a todo list app with Next.js that persists todos in localStorage and runs on port 3011.

shapes.name: tool_g
shapes.instruction: Create src/hooks/useTodos.ts exporting a useTodos hook that loads todos from localStorage, exposes add, toggle and remove actions, and keeps the list in React state so the page re-renders after every change. python_cli.goal: Create a small Python CLI in greeter.py that reads a name from stdin or args and prints a greeting.
python_cli.instruction: Implement the greeting command: read the name from the first argument or stdin and print a non-empty greeting that changes with the name.
